properties.displayName: AKS node images should be no older than the approved minimum build date
properties.description: Audits every AKS cluster and flags it as non-compliant when any Linux node pool is running a node image whose build date is older than the approved minimum. AKS node image versions are formatted as '<distro>-<sku>-<YYYYMM>.<DD>.<rev>' (for example 'AKSUbuntu-2204gen2containerd-202506.10.0'), so this policy extracts the leading YYYYMM build month and compares it ordinally against the minimumNodeImageDate parameter. Windows node pools use a different version format and are excluded. Effect is Audit only: nodeImageVersion is a read-only ARM property, so Deny is not meaningful.

metadata.description: Six-digit YYYYMM string. Any Linux node pool whose node image build month sorts before this value is non-compliant. Bump this value on your patch cadence (for example monthly, to the previous month).
Clusters carrying this tag with the value 'true' are skipped. Set to an unused tag name to disable the escape hatch.
Audit flags non-compliant clusters. Disabled turns the policy off.
